units.source_text: 丈夫听到这里，才动了下嘴唇。

en.t: Only after hearing this did my husband move his lips a little.

units.source_text: 他嘴里还满是竹叶，自然没有声响。

en.t: His mouth was still full of bamboo leaves, so naturally no sound came out.

units.source_text: 不过我看他嘴动，立刻了解了他说的是什么。

en.t: But when I saw his mouth move, I immediately understood what he had said.

units.source_text: 他始终轻蔑的看待我，说的是“杀吧。”

en.t: He looked at me with contempt to the very end, and what he said was, Kill me.

units.source_text: 我如梦魇一般，“噗呲“一下将小刀插进了穿着淡蓝色短上衣的丈夫的胸口。

en.t: As if trapped in a nightmare, I thrust the small knife with a soft stab into the chest of my husband in his pale blue short jacket.
